note: Round 4. Calibration keeps C1-C6, K1 and K2 (round 3). Every earlier held-out window (round 1 E2-E4, round 2 H1 and H3-H5, round 3 Q1-Q5) is used-holdout: scored before, never tuned on here, and never shown to the photo detector during fine-tuning; reported for comparison. A new held-out sample (W1-W5) in parts of the inner area no earlier window used (the conifer wood by the 8th tee, the wood between the 11th and 12th, the 7th hole broadleaf edge, the south end of the 8th and 9th, and the 9-hole course between its 1st and 4th) is declared and frozen before any round-4 detector runs near it, and before the photo detector is run anywhere. Its strata follow the detect census near play (closed 53%, edge 32%, group 10%, isolated 5% of apexes within 90 m of a hole line): two closed squares, two edges and a group window. Windows were chosen from the detector-neutral apex census of the pit-free CHM (the reference panels numbering filter) and the play-zone distance only; no detector output was looked at inside them.

declaredBeforeScoring.beatsRoundThree: the owner rule of 2026-11-08 ("The best round go!"): the round-4 detector is published only if, on the new evaluation sample (W1-W5), its F1 AND its recall are higher than the round-3 lock (detector-lock-r3.json) on the same sample, with precision at least 0.95; the round-2 lock is scored on the same sample for comparison. If it also reaches precision and recall of at least 0.9 the gate passes outright.
declaredBeforeScoring.strata: recall by stratum (isolated, group, edge, closed), by type and by height (3-8, 8-15, 15+ m) is reported with the totals
declaredBeforeScoring.secondary: round 4 is also reported on round 3 sample (Q1-Q5, used-holdout) as a secondary number; it decides nothing
